description: Reasoned exceptions to scripts/test-audience.mjs. Each entry excuses one audience-guard match in one file. `match` is an exact substring of the string, not a line number, so it survives edits. An entry that no longer matches anything fails the guard, so the list cannot rot.

entries.match: you have to keep working throughout the period you receive SU
entries.reason: This is the grant's own record, and the sentence is one of the equal-status routes: it states who can claim, it does not assume it.

entries.match: In another Nordic country SU is paid as if you studied in Denmark
entries.reason: The grant's own record, in the 'abroad' block that is only ever rendered after the record's condition of who can claim it.

entries.match: Danish SU changes on 1 January 2027 for this cohort
entries.reason: A freshness rule about when grant data goes stale, not an offer of the grant to the reader.

entries.match: Danish SU and udlandsstipendium rules for six-year medical degrees abroad were not verified
entries.reason: A not-checked note recording a research gap; it offers the grant to nobody.

entries.match: Danish applicants mostly do not move that far south
entries.reason: Describes where Danish applicants choose to live, explaining why Sønderborg's student body is international; it does not treat the reader as Danish.

entries.match: Danish applicants mostly do not move that far south
entries.reason: Same sentence as data/dk/sdu.json, in the canonical Institution record.

entries.match: SU is limited to the prescribed duration of your
entries.reason: The SU reform note on the Denmark money page, which sits directly under the rendered who-can-claim list from data/funding/dk-su.json.
The NemKonto admin step, which names SU as one of the public bodies that pays into it; not an offer of SU.

Rendered on /trust/ as one example among several ("a Danish student … or a French student") of why category names do not translate; it describes how a term reads to someone from a system, not the reader's nationality.

entries.match: study assistance from another state, which includes Danish SU
entries.reason: Reports Iceland's own rule that its student loan cannot be combined with another state's grant; it names Danish SU as an example, it does not offer it.

entries.match: moving to Iceland as a Nordic national
entries.reason: The title of Registers Iceland's own page for Nordic nationals, cited as a source; it names the page, it does not address the reader.
